BUILDING & REMODELING

Expand your home with thoughtfully designed additions that blend seamlessly with your existing structure. Full Kitchen remodels, Bathroom renovations, Basement finishes, from extra bedrooms, mother-in-law apartments to home offices - we can serve all your home building needs in Western Michigan.

SEE OUR SERVICES
JBJ BUILDING & REMODELING INC.

Welcome to JBJ BUILDING & REMODELING INC., your dedicated partner in custom home building and remodeling services. As a family-owned business rooted in Western Michigan since 2002, we bring a personalized, hands-on approach to every project. Specializing in custom bathroom and kitchen remodels, as well as a broad range of custom construction services, we are committed to transforming your house into the dream home you envision. 

JBJ BUILDING & REMODELING - Proudly serving Ada, Rockford & East Grand Rapids for more than 20 years.

These guys are the real deal. They are no nonsense. Just diligent and high quality labor.

We will definitely be hiring them again for future work!

Bathroom remodel, beautiful job, but the attention to detail is what impressed me the most. The level of the tile, the built in linen cabinet where they nailed, puttied and sanded, it is so perfect. Don did a great job.
Read more
Ron Wager
3 years ago
Jamie & his crew did an amazing job on our master bathroom. We new Jamie was the person we wanted to work with, right from the start. We interviewed numerous builders, but Jamie was the one that brought logical ideas to the project. He shared great ideas that wouldn't break the bank but stay with the style of the house while making the room feel larger. Other than a few "Covid Delays", the project went pretty smooth. Jamie was adamant to not cut corners & do this project the way we designed it, even though it will take a little longer. This was great advice because we couldn't be happier with how it turned out. Thanks JBJ Building & Remodeling!
Read more
Pat Koczenasz
3 years ago
We are in LOVE with our newly remodeled bathroom! Working with JBJ was a breeze! Although it took longer than expected, the finished product is beautiful and beyond our expectations. Everyone was friendly, knowledgeable and attentive to detail. Especially Jamie and Don! We were sad to see them go. We will use them for any future projects and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality, craftsmanship and all around great work! Thank you, JBJ Team!

3 years ago
Can not recommend them enough!!! We hired Jamie and crew after a previous contractor left us midway through our kitchen remodel. They were responsive, professional and did great work. We are thrilled to finally have our kitchen completed. I only wish we would have went to them to start with.
